ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio with approximately 45% high-intensity white/light-gray pixels localized at the distal regions and 55% low-intensity black pixels concentrated at the medial and basal areas.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white blobs occupy the distal tips of both lobes; the medial-basal region is characterized by a solid low-intensity black mass; high-frequency dark mottling and focal spots are distributed throughout the white distal regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated acute pixel angle and high bounding-box depth relative to lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with varying pixel-amplitudes (jagged peaks and valleys) extracted along the entire continuous trailing edge of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve fitted to the lower trailing edges, transitioning to a sharper upward sweep at the distal tips of the lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular white pixel groups (barnacles) densely localized at the extreme distal tips and along segments of the trailing edges.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct, vertical high-intensity linear pixel disruption (rake mark) visible on the inner-right lobe surface, breaking the dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on the distal margins and a prominent vertical rake mark on the right ventral lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy concentration of white circular anomalies (barnacles) forming a distinctive textured boundary on the lateral-most tips of the fluke.
